text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Work starts on major expansion of Aluminium Bahrain's power unit at a cost of 200 million dinars.
- Bahrain joins other nations in ratifying the international convention banning the use and manufacture of chemical weapons.
- South Africa seeks to boost bilateral trade with Bahrain.
- Arab Ship Repair Yard posts $89.5 million profit in the first quarter of 1997.
- Bahrain and Middle East Bank studies possibility of investing in eastern Europe.
- Around 200 firms from 51 countries seek role in development projects in Bahrain, official says.
